summary: Former Wehrmacht medic and lay preacher Paul Schäfer fled child-abuse charges in Germany to found Colonia Dignidad in Chile in 1961, a sealed cult where he raped children for decades and ran a torture and execution site for Pinochet's secret police.

evidence.note: birth in the Siegburg/Bonn area in 1921; birthplace disputed
postwar orphanage near Troisdorf for widows and children, used to prey on boys
long digression on William Branham, his healing revival and link to Jim Jones
1961 move to Chile and purchase of the ranch that became Colonia Dignidad
members forced into twelve-hour days of hard labor; quarry and farm businesses
colony hospital used for drugging and electroshock punishment of a captive boy
1973 coup; colony becomes a torture site for Pinochet's DINA
Luis Peebles tortured at the colony in 1975 with Schäfer instructing
1980 reporting on the colony as a waystation for fugitive Nazis
1996 boarding-school rape case triggers raids; Schäfer goes underground
Schäfer found and arrested in a gated community in Buenos Aires
dies in a prison hospital in 2010; Villa Baviera and Hopp extradition fight follow

notes: The transcript garbles several years (birth, arrest); 1921 birth and 2010 death taken from general knowledge, consistent with the stated age of 88. main_span starts at the 1961 founding of the colony, though the German orphanage abuse and 1959 warrant are also covered. CL-ML assumes Parral lies in the Maule region. Pinochet's regime is treated as authoritarianism rather than fascism-far-right.
